description: Avianca LifeMiles for a flight operated by Avianca, fare in US dollars (whole ticket, without taxes, fees and extras). when picks the rules: 2027 (flights from 1 January 2027, the default from that date) or 2026. 2027: LifeMiles = fare x (status rate: member 2, Red Plus 3, Silver 5, Gold 8, Diamond 9, Magno 10; plus fare bonus: Basic and Light 0, Classic 1, Flex and Business 2), rounded down, no percentage bonus; qualifying miles = fare x 5, or x 8 for a domestic flight in Colombia by a member enrolled in Colombia (route DCO; INT international, DOM domestic for others); progress toward Red Plus (5,000), Silver (10,000), Gold (20,000), Diamond (40,000) and Magno (90,000), the minimum earned with Avianca not checked. 2026: LifeMiles = fare x rate by fare family (Basic and Light 3, Classic 6, Flex 8, Business 10), plus an Elite bonus of that base (Red Plus 10%, Silver 20%, Gold 60%, Diamond 80%, Magno 100%), rounded down; qualifying miles = the base LifeMiles plus 1 per 20 bonus LifeMiles; progress toward Red Plus (6,000), Silver (12,000), Gold (24,000), Diamond (45,000) and Magno (110,000). qm is the qualifying miles so far in the calendar year. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Avianca's own: united = United MileagePlus (creditStatus one of: General member, Premier Silver, Premier Gold, Premier Platinum, Premier 1K); aeroplan = Aeroplan (creditStatus one of: Aeroplan Member, 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K, Super Elite). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

fare.description: Fare family. BS = Basic (3 per $1, domestic flights; no fare bonus from 2027); LT = Light (3 per $1, international flights; no fare bonus from 2027); CL = Classic (6 per $1; +1 per $1 from 2027); FX = Flex (8 per $1; +2 per $1 from 2027); BZ = Business (10 per $1; +2 per $1 from 2027; Business Classic, Business Flex, INSIGNIA). Shown on your booking. Avianca does not publish booking class letters for its fare families.

price.description: Fare paid (USD, whole ticket) in US dollars. In US dollars: the fare for the whole ticket without taxes, fees and additional services (bags, seats and other extras). Required unless creditTo is given.

qm.description: Qualifying miles you have so far this year (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next Elite status.

route.description: Flight. INT = International flight (5 qualifying miles per $1); DOM = Domestic flight in Colombia, enrolled in another country (5 qualifying miles per $1); DCO = Domestic flight in Colombia, enrolled in Colombia (8 qualifying miles per $1). From 2027, qualifying miles depend on the route and, for domestic flights, the country where you enrolled in LifeMiles. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

status.description: Your LifeMiles Elite status when you fly. NO = No Elite status (no bonus; 2 per $1 from 2027); RP = Red Plus (10% bonus; 3 per $1 from 2027); SV = Silver (20% bonus; 5 per $1 from 2027); GD = Gold (60% bonus; 8 per $1 from 2027); DI = Diamond (80% bonus; 9 per $1 from 2027); MG = Magno (100% bonus; 10 per $1 from 2027).

when.description: When do you fly?. 2026 = Through Dec 31, 2026; 2027 = From Jan 1, 2027. Avianca's new LifeMiles earning starts with flights on Jan 1, 2027.
